Solution: fixed by 8SFXCJC (82499e0d, bf7c4e76), which did exactly what this ticket asked for. `startGuiAutoSync` no longer gates the broadcast on `pulled || createdCommit || bootstrapped`; it holds a `logSignature` of the state branch and broadcasts when the log moved, whatever the sync reported. Remote-independent, so a sibling TUI's writes reach the GUI with no origin, and an unchanged log no longer clobbers clients.

Verified by reading `source/gui/api/lib/api-autosync.ts` — the `attempted`/`currentSignature` pair replaces the old gate.

add.issue.comment.md:
Solution: settled on option A — one ticket ref per commit, as a leading subject prefix. No code change; A is what the whole dependent chain was built against and it has shipped: the commit↔ticket match is a prefix match, 1YRTG8T documented the convention in the readme, and the epiq skill and the `check-commit-ref` commit-msg hook both enforce it.

Option B (an `Epiq-Refs:` trailer for a commit touching two tickets) was never ruled out, only unneeded. It stays additive — matching a trailer alongside the prefix breaks nothing that exists — so it can be raised as a fresh ticket if a commit ever genuinely needs to name two tickets. Closing rather than leaving the question parked, since nothing is waiting on the answer.
